subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC discovery
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Sarah Patel <s.patel@acmehealth.com>, James O'Connor <j.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 3:02 PM PDT
Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC discovery

Hi Sarah + James — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard, the main pain points, and proposed next steps so we have alignment. Please correct anything I missed.

Summary of pain points and goals
- Primary drivers: regulatory/data residency (HIPAA) and desire for an air-gapped or VPC-isolated deployment for PHI workloads.
- Current pain: inconsistent latency across cloud regions, and inability to send PHI to multi-tenant hosted APIs.
- Security asks: KMS/HSM integration, SOC2 evidence, audit logs retention policy, and egress controls on outbound telemetry.
- Networking constraints: strict inbound-only connectivity from Acme VPC to Redwood control plane (no outbound VPN allowed from your side), specific firewall rules and a limited set of proxy endpoints.

What Redwood can offer (high-level)
- Private VPC deployment with customer-managed networking and optional air-gapped on-prem package.
- KMS/HSM key wrapping, audit logs, and SOC2 artifacts provisioned during the procurement process.
- We can propose a dedicated capacity pool for predictable latency and pin model versions for reproducibility.

Action items / next steps
1) I attached a short "VPC networking requirements" PDF with the ports/IPs we typically need — can your network team review and flag any blockers? (attachment: acme_vpc_network_requirements.pdf)
2) Technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer (Priyom) to map your firewall/proxy constraints and to confirm whether an air-gapped on-prem install is required. Proposed slots: Tue 4/5 10am PT or Wed 4/6 9am PT.
3) Security questionnaire: we'll send the SOC2 and encryption docs; please let us know if you need an NDA before sharing.
4) Procurement intro: James mentioned procurement should be looped for timelines and contract type. If you share a procurement contact we can send preliminary commercial guidance and a draft SOW.

Please reply with preferred deep-dive time and any immediate redlines on the attached network requirements doc.

Thanks again — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: acme_vpc_network_requirements.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
Attachment: redwood_private_deploy_overview.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

From: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Sarah Patel <s.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 4:10 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC discovery

Camila — thanks for the clear summary. This matches our notes from today. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirming regulatory scope: we must retain all PHI in-region (US) and demonstrate encryption at rest with customer-managed keys. HIPAA compliance is non-negotiable.
- Networking: we do not allow outbound VPNs from our VPCs. The architecture we are open to is an inbound-only proxy into our private network or an approved peering arrangement.
- Timeline: procurement will need an initial estimate for monthly committed cost + any one-time setup fees to budget for Q3.

Please include procurement on the next email — procurement@acmehealth.com is the right contact. Also please share your SOC2 report and any specific data residency docs so we can pre-check with compliance ASAP.

On scheduling, Tue 4/5 10am PT works for a technical deep-dive for us.

Thanks,
James
Director, Cloud Platform
AcmeHealth
j.oconnor@acmehealth.com

--
Note: please CC procurement@acmehealth.com on pricing/commercial follow-ups.

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, Apr 3, 2027 at 9:14 AM PDT
Subject: Internal: AcmeHealth technical deep-dive prep (Tue 4/5 10am PT)

Looping in the notes from today's prep and the items I plan to cover on Tue's call — internal checklist for the deep-dive so we present concrete asks to Acme.

Tech deep-dive agenda (30–45m)
- Introductions (5m)
- Current infra summary from Acme (VPC layout, NAT/proxy config, egress rules) (10m)
- Network topology options we support: inbound proxy, VPC peering, private link-like patterns, and on-prem air-gap considerations (10m)
- KMS/HSM integration options and key rotation flow (5m)
- Dataflow and audit log retention discussion (5m)

Prep items (Prio order)
1) Get completed network diagram from Acme (ask: CIDR blocks, firewall appliance IPs, outbound proxy FQDNs).
2) Prepare a concise matrix of ports/IPs & NAT behaviour for the team to validate against their firewall (I'll use the attached PDF as the basis).
3) Pull SOC2 summary and KMS integration notes to share during the call.
4) Draft an initial ops playbook for data deletion/retention timelines to show compliance capabilities.

Proposed deliverables after call
- A short "network fit" memo with recommended architecture (inbound proxy vs peering) and any blockers.
- Statement of Work (high-level) and ballpark pricing ranges for Dedicated capacity vs On-prem air-gapped installation.

Camila — I'll take action item 2 and 3. Marissa — could you pull the SOC2 summary and latest audit date so we can share? Lauren — FYI for potential exec escalation if procurement pushes on pricing.

Thanks — see you on Tue.

Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

--
